nodes.description: Admin address of the delegator, inherited from BTokenStorage; written from msg.sender in the constructor and required to authorize _setImplementation.
Address of the delegated implementation contract (BDelegationStorage); every delegatecall target in the delegator.
Underlying EIP-20 asset address stored in BErc20Storage and initialized through the delegatecall initialization.
Reentrancy guard flag defined in BTokenStorage; never enforced in the delegator, so delegatecall paths are unguarded at this layer.
BErc20Delegator constructor: sets admin = msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize on the implementation, sets implementation, then restores admin_.
Admin-only function that changes the implementation address, optionally resigning the old one, and delegates _becomeImplementation to the new implementation.
Internal helper performing callee.delegatecall(data) and reverting on failure with returned data.
Public function that calls delegateTo(implementation, data), exposing a delegatecall entry point to arbitrary external callers.
Private function performing implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) and returning or reverting with raw returndata; used by all state-changing wrappers and the fallback.
Public view function that staticcalls address(this) with delegateToImplementation(bytes) to read from the implementation.
Private view function that staticcalls delegateToImplementation(bytes) with msg.data and returns the raw returndata via assembly.
Payable fallback that rejects value and forwards all calldata to the implementation through delegateAndReturn.
External caller address; used as initial admin, as the access-control check in _setImplementation, and preserved across delegatecalls.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) inside delegateTo: executes attacker-influenced calldata in this contract's storage context.
Low-level implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) inside delegateAndReturn: forwards arbitrary caller calldata into the implementation with this contract's storage.
staticcall to address(this) inside delegateToViewAndReturn with raw msg.data, followed by assembly returndatacopy and return.
staticcall to address(this) inside delegateToViewImplementation, abi-decoding the returned bytes.
External mint(uint) wrapper that discards mintAmount and forwards the raw call to delegateAndReturn.
External borrow(uint) wrapper that discards borrowAmount and forwards the raw call to delegateAndReturn.
External seize(address,address,uint) wrapper that discards its arguments and forwards the raw call to delegateAndReturn.
New implementation address passed to _setImplementation.
Raw calldata bytes passed to delegateTo for the delegatecall.
Delegatecall target address passed to delegateTo.
Local holding the previous implementation address before _setImplementation overwrites it.
Amount argument of mint, intentionally unused in the delegator wrapper.
Amount argument of borrow, intentionally unused in the delegator wrapper.
Token amount argument of seize, intentionally unused in the delegator wrapper.
Encoded bytes forwarded to _becomeImplementation on the new implementation.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, making the deployer the initial admin of the delegator.
Constructor writes the admin storage variable both at the start (msg.sender) and at the end (admin_ parameter).
_setImplementation gates on require(msg.sender == admin); if admin is misconfigured or renounced the implementation can never be swapped.
Constructor builds the initialize(...) calldata and delegatecalls it through delegateTo.
Constructor calls _setImplementation after the initialize delegatecall to register the implementation.
The implementation_ parameter is written directly into the implementation state variable.
_setImplementation overwrites the implementation storage slot with the new address.
_setImplementation reads the current implementation into the local oldImplementation before overwriting it.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation to run _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation on the implementation.
becomeImplementationData is ABI-encoded and passed to the implementation during _setImplementation.
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo(implementation, data) without further access control.
delegateToImplementation ultimately triggers the callee.delegatecall(data) unsafe operation.
The data parameter is the raw calldata handed to the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
The callee parameter is the target address of the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data), the core unsafe operation of the delegator.
delegateAndReturn reads the implementation state variable to pick the delegatecall target.
delegateAndReturn executes implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) and returns raw returndata through assembly.
msg.sender is preserved across the delegatecall in delegateAndReturn, so the implementation sees the original caller.
mint discards mintAmount and forwards msg.data to delegateAndReturn.
borrow discards borrowAmount and forwards msg.data to delegateAndReturn.
seize discards its arguments and forwards msg.data to delegateAndReturn.
The mintAmount parameter is evaluated and discarded ('Shh') inside the mint wrapper.
The borrowAmount parameter is evaluated and discarded inside the borrow wrapper.
The seizeTokens parameter is evaluated and discarded inside the seize wrapper.
The fallback forwards any unmatched calldata to delegateAndReturn after checking msg.value == 0.
The fallback delegates arbitrary calldata to the implementation; since _notEntered is never enforced in the delegator, a malicious implementation or token can re-enter through the fallback.
The implementation.delegatecall in delegateAndReturn runs external code in this contract's context without any reentrancy guard, enabling re-entrant state changes.
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls address(this).delegateToImplementation(bytes), an indirect call back into the delegator.
delegateToViewImplementation performs the staticcall unsafe operation to reach the implementation.
delegateToViewAndReturn staticcalls delegateToImplementation(bytes) with raw msg.data on address(this).
delegateToViewAndReturn performs the staticcall and assembly returndatacopy/return unsafe operation.
